annotations.title: Stock and crypto returns by market regime

description: How has this stock or crypto typically done in markets like today's? Returns, for one stock or crypto symbol per call (any US stock, plus the covered crypto list), its typical return and how often it rose over 1 to 12 months from the current regime. Stocks add sensitivity versus the S&P 500 and up to 5 peer symbols. A symbol with no price data is free. $0.01 per call in USDC on Base, Polygon or Solana (x402). Settled figures, updated after each US close (coins daily). The same figures as the symbol's page on regimecard.com. Useful when an agent needs a stock lookup: stock data, stock returns by market regime or crypto returns by market regime.

inputSchema.description: A JSON object with exactly one field: symbol, or the earlier symbols with one entry. One symbol per call. A second symbol is a second call.

symbol.description: One stock or crypto symbol: any US stock, or a coin on the covered crypto list, for example "NVDA" or "BTC". Upper or lower case. One symbol per call.

symbols.description: The earlier form of the same input: a list with exactly one stock or crypto symbol, for example ["NVDA"].

items.description: One stock, ETF or crypto symbol.

name: lookup_symbols

asOf.description: The trading session this response describes (YYYY-MM-DD, US Eastern).

disclaimer.const: For informational purposes only. Not investment advice.

record.description: The public, hash-linked record of the daily settled regime reading: its percentile and its regime label. It covers nothing else in this response: not the stress gate, stock or coin figures, the scorecard, or a live intraday reading. The same on every response.

covers.description: The reading it covers: the percentile and the regime label of each daily settled reading, and nothing else in this response.

ledger.description: Every entry as JSON, each with the hash of the entry before it.

note.const: Each settled regime reading is added to a public, hash-linked record the day it is published; a correction is a new entry, never an edit.
note.description: The same facts in one plain sentence.

verify.description: The page that explains the hash chain and checks every entry in the browser.

key.description: The regime, as a stable key.

label.description: The regime, as the card prints it.

related.description: The other paid routes: for each, its path, the question it answers and its price per call. Each is a separate call.

path.description: The route's path on this origin.

per.description: What the price is for: one call, or each covered symbol of one call.

priceUsd.description: The price in US dollars, paid in USDC.

research.description: A published Regime Card study of the current regime. Present only when one exists for it.

items.description: One entry: the symbol asked for.

asOf.description: The session of the symbol's newest price in the figures (YYYY-MM-DD).

covered.description: False when Regime Card cannot serve this symbol: it has no price history, or its price series stopped. Never an error.

horizons.description: One row per holding period, for the current regime.

history.description: How much history is behind the row: full, limited, or none (too little to print a figure).

roseSharePct.description: How often the symbol rose over the period when it started in the current regime, in percent of past periods.

typicalReturnPct.description: The typical (median) return over the period when it started in the current regime, in percent.

page.description: Present, and false, on a US stock served on demand: it is outside the stocks that have a page on regimecard.com, so it carries no url and no peers.

peers.description: For a stock: up to 5 peer symbols from the symbol's page. Symbols only, no figures.

peersNote.description: Present with peers: what a peer's figures cost.

sensitivity.description: For a stock: how much its typical 3-month return moves from one regime to another, as a multiple of the S&P 500's. The figure on the symbol's page. Absent when the page prints none.

symbol.description: The symbol as asked, upper case, a dotted share class with its dash (BRK.B is BRK-B).

url.description: The symbol's page on regimecard.com, with the same figures. Absent for a stock served on demand.

status.description: "live": computed during the session and still provisional. "settled": final for its session.

oneOf.description: The answer for a symbol Regime Card cannot serve. It is free: no payment is asked for it, and a payment that was attached is never verified or settled. Never an error.

asOf.description: The trading session this response describes (YYYY-MM-DD, US Eastern).

covered.description: Always false here: Regime Card cannot serve this symbol. It has no price history, or its price series stopped.

disclaimer.const: For informational purposes only. Not investment advice.

status.description: "live": computed during the session and still provisional. "settled": final for its session.
